params.1273: Given by the town crier in East Ardougne's market for completing all Medium Tasks in Ardougne.
params.1292: Ardougne cloak 2 and a magic lamp worth 7,500xp in a skill of your choice. Wizard Cromperty will offer you 100 noted essence per day.
params.1274: The cloak gains the following extra benefits:
params.1275: - Teleport to the Farming patch north of Ardougne once per day.
params.1276: - Improved rate of success when picking pockets in Ardougne.
params.1277: - Double length PvP immunity after pulling the Wilderness teleport lever.
params.1278: - 60% of items dropped in the Tower of Life will be noted.
params.1279: - Improved yield from crafting runes at Ourania Altar.
params.1280: Talk to the town crier to toggle your ring of life teleport destination to Ardougne.
